business_problem: Gruppo BCC ICCREA needed to connect third-party digital services to its mainframe core-banking applications and monitor those interactions without creating auditing gaps, performance blind spots, or extra strain on specialist mainframe administrators.
solution_summary: ICCREA partnered with IBM Consulting and IBM Technology Expert Labs to build a hybrid integration layer around its IBM Z mainframe environment. IBM z/OS Connect exposes secured REST API invocation directly from core banking applications, while IBM WebSphere Liberty provides the runtime aligned with the bank's broader cloud-application strategy. To close the observability gap, IBM Z Operational Log and Data Analytics exports operational data and logs from the mainframe into ICCREA's Elasticsearch-based monitoring stack, giving the bank unified visibility across established systems and external services. Together, those components let ICCREA integrate third-party services without rewriting core banking logic, reuse existing monitoring practices, and improve incident resolution and auditability. The design effectively modernized the interface around the mainframe rather than replacing it, which fits the bank's need for reliable innovation on top of existing core systems.

data_flow: Core banking applications on IBM Z call external REST services through z/OS Connect and WebSphere Liberty, while operational logs from those interactions are exported by IBM Z Operational Log and Data Analytics into Elasticsearch so the bank can audit, monitor, and troubleshoot the hybrid transaction flow in one place.
business_outcome: ICCREA reduced integration effort, lowered recurring operational overhead, improved incident management, and created a more scalable, observable way to connect external services to its mainframe banking systems.
